verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy for Trigger.dev's APIs. Task-code versioning, where runs are locked to a deployed code version, is a different feature. A community note says v3 code was 'deprecated in v4', which shows major SDK versions exist, but neither item documents a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
